# Video Equipment Research

Section: Research Path > Unlocked by

## Video Equipment

[![Videoequipmentresearch](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/1/11/Videoequipmentresearch.png/revision/latest?cb=20240421190232)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/1/11/Videoequipmentresearch.png/revision/latest?cb=20240421190232)

### Research Points

30

### Research Time

3h 40m

## Research Path

### Unlocked by

[Displays](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Displays_Research), [Advanced Displays](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Advanced_Displays_Research)

Video equipment is a [researchable](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Research) item which unlocks the following components:

| [Displays](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Displays) | Monitor 5x3 |
| [Displays](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Displays) | Monitor 9x5 |
| [Displays](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Displays) | Monitor 1x2 |
| [Displays](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Displays) | Monitor 1x3 |
| [Displays](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Displays) | Monitor 2x3 |
| [Displays](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Displays) | Monitor 3x3 |
| Specialist Equipment | Camera Small |
